scenarios.description: A compressed historical summary should produce at least one meaningful editorial suggestion.
scenarios.userGuidance: Lean into vivid narrative detail while staying factual and grounded in the original meaning.

paragraphs.text: The factory opened in 1923. It produced steel for decades. The work was dangerous.
Workers came from nearby towns and built a close community around the mill.
By the 1980s, the buildings were mostly silent.

scenarios.description: Academic prose with explicit guidance should return a focused narrative-oriented suggestion.
scenarios.userGuidance: Make the prose more narrative and less academic while preserving the original meaning.

paragraphs.text: The methodology employed a mixed-methods approach and yielded a range of observations regarding daily life in the district.
Residents described the market as the center of conversation, trade, and routine.
